mapper.sql: p.id, p.title, p.slug, p.summary, p.cover_image, p.status, p.pinned, p.view_count, p.published_at, p.author_id, p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.nickname AS author_name, u.avatar AS author_avatar

p.id, p.title, p.slug, p.summary, p.content, p.cover_image, p.status, p.pinned, p.view_count, p.published_at, p.author_id, p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.nickname AS author_name, u.avatar AS author_avatar
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (title, slug, summary, content, cover_image, status, pinned, view_count, published_at, author_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{slug}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{coverImage}, #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{pinned}, #{viewCount}, #{publishedAt}, #{authorId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM posts p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.author_id = u.id WHERE p.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM posts p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.author_id = u.id WHERE p.slug = #{slug} LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM posts p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.author_id = u.id WHERE p.status = #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler} ORDER BY p.pinned DESC, p.published_at DESC, p.created_at DESC
SELECT FROM posts p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.author_id = u.id WHERE p.author_id = #{authorId} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT FROM posts p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.author_id = u.id INNER JOIN post_tags pt ON p.id = pt.post_id INNER JOIN tags t ON pt.tag_id = t.id WHERE t.slug = #{tagSlug} AND p.status = #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler} ORDER BY p.published_at DESC, p.created_at DESC

SELECT FROM posts p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.author_id = u.id WHERE p.status = #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler} AND ( p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY p.published_at DESC, p.created_at DESC
SELECT FROM posts p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.author_id = u.id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM posts WHERE slug = #{slug}
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM posts WHERE status = #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM posts WHERE author_id = #{authorId}
